schematic_semantics.classification: Three independent trainings have a common initialization, not a jointly trained ensemble; held-out images enter only frozen inference.
schematic_semantics.segmentation: Two independent dimension-matched U-Nets use a common objective and selection protocol; selected frozen models process entire test grids.
schematic_semantics.unet: Five encoder scales, four max pools, four transposed convolutions, concatenation skips, two-logit output.

captions.method_overview: Study design and evaluation. a, Three independently trained ResNet-50 classifiers share an ImageNet-1K V2 initialization and image preparation, differing only in their training objective. Each checkpoint is selected on the official validation set by accuracy, with macro F1 as a tie-breaker, then evaluated on 1,512 held-out dermoscopy images. b, Left-atrial MRI training uses 11 of the 14 supplied source volumes, with three retained for validation. Case-uniform, partly foreground-centred sampling supplies either 2D patches or 3D patches to U-Nets with matched channel widths. Checkpoints are selected by mean foreground Dice on complete validation volumes. Frozen models reconstruct the full grids of 20 test volumes using Gaussian probability fusion. ASD and HD95 are expressed in voxel units because physical image spacing is unavailable. The modality icons are illustrative vector drawings rather than dataset images or anatomical evidence. Supplementary sensitivity runs performed after inspection of the primary test results are outside this primary design.
captions.unet_architecture: U-Net architecture and patch scales. a, Both segmentation models have five encoder scales, four max-pooling operations, and four decoder scales with transposed-convolution upsampling. At each decoder scale, the upsampled features are concatenated with encoder features at the same resolution, then processed by a double-convolution block. Each convolution is followed by affine instance normalization and ReLU. The architecture uses 2D or 3D operations throughout, with base width 16 and a two-logit output. b, Spatial sizes after each encoder block for the actual 2D and 3D training patches. The decoder restores the original patch resolution. General inputs are padded to multiples of 16 before the forward pass and the final logits are cropped to the original size.

alt_text.method_overview: Two independent left-to-right pipelines show training and held-out evaluation separately. Dermoscopy uses shared initial ResNet-50 weights and three loss alternatives; MRI compares 2D and 3D U-Nets. Validation chooses each checkpoint; test inputs feed frozen inference and metric calculation only.
alt_text.unet_architecture: A U-shaped encoder-decoder has channel widths 16, 32, 64, 128 and 256 on the encoder, then 128, 64, 32 and 16 on the decoder. Four matching-scale skips are concatenated. A table lists all spatial dimensions of the 2D and 3D patches.
